main_body: Wooden bin (front face rows 10-14) with a dark coal heap rising above its rim and two thin brown side-wall strips at the left and right of the heap
top_band: No real top band. Column x=8 reads: near-black coal #131317 rows 3-9, a single light brown rim row 10 (#8a6038, L=104), then the front face from row 11 to row 14.
evidence: The only horizontal surface on the bin is the 1-row light brown rim at row 10, which is rim-only and too thin to read as a top. The coal above it is one flat near-black mass (L=19) that merges with the outline, so it reads as a silhouette heap seen from the front. It does not show an inner opening surface with a back rim and a front rim. The front face has a dark row under the rim, but the planks are painted flat. The box is a front elevation with a thin lip, and the heap is not enough to make it a 3/4 container.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The coal is a near-black mass with only a couple of lighter speckles. The wood has few steps: a rim highlight, a dark band, and a mid plank tone. Neutral near-black outline and coal pixels are mixed with brown wood tones, giving a sticker-like look, and 29% of dark edge pixels are neutral. It is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
